summary: PetAdmin iteration 2 end-to-end verification. Backend: 8/8 new pytest tests pass against the public URL covering GET /api/bookings/{id} enriched response (price/paid_total/outstanding/payments), POST /api/payments updating paid_total+outstanding, status persistence across all 4 values (confirmed/completed/cancelled/no_show), POST /api/bookings default status=confirmed, past-dated confirmed booking NOT auto-moving to completed after dashboard + list GETs, dashboard outstanding_total including non-cancelled unpaid bookings (not only completed), customer timeline containing newly-recorded payment, cancelled bookings excluded from dashboard outstanding. Frontend web (1280x900): PetAdmin loads as website (document.title='PetAdmin'), login flow works with demo@petadmin.app/petadmin123, dashboard Outstanding card dropped £773.77 → £772.77 after recording a £1.00 payment confirming end-to-end integration. Booking detail shows Total/Paid/Outstanding breakdown. All 4 status chips (confirmed/completed/cancelled/no_show) are present and tappable; setting a booking to Cancelled persists after back+reopen (Cancelled StatusPill still visible). New booking created from dashboard defaults to Confirmed and returns to dashboard. No red-screen errors. Only non-blocking console warning repeated from iteration 1: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' (React Native Web deprecation, carried over). Deprecated packages detected: none.

issues: Console warning (carried over from iter 1): '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Not blocking.

action_items: Optional: migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow in theme/components to silence RN Web deprecation warning (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:681-699 dashboard 'billable' aggregation does N+1 payments.aggregate() per booking — fine for demo volumes but should be a single $lookup/$group pipeline before scale.
server.py:593-601 POST /bookings/{id}/status accepts raw dict; works but a Pydantic model (StatusIn) would give cleaner 422 errors instead of 400 on malformed JSON.
booking/[id].tsx:111 isPaid uses `outstanding <= 0.01 && total > 0` — correctly handles zero-price bookings. OK.
seed_data_creation: Used existing demo@petadmin.app seeded tenant. Tests created several extra bookings + a few £1.00/half-price payments which remain in the tenant (not cleaned up — safe because they do not block retests).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three user-reported fixes are verified end-to-end: (1) booking detail breakdown + payment recording reduces outstanding and surfaces in customer timeline; (2) status is manual-only — new bookings default to confirmed, past-dated confirmed bookings stay confirmed across GETs/dashboard calls, all 4 chips persist after navigation; (3) runs correctly as a website at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with title 'PetAdmin'. Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (iter 1) + /app/backend/tests/test_booking_payments.py (iter 2). Dashboard outstanding is now computed across all non-cancelled bookings — expect larger values than the pre-fix 'completed only' baseline.
